# Warlock Sitemap

> Package: `@warlock.js/sitemap`

> A framework-blind sitemap builder: entries in, a valid sitemaps.org document out. Zero runtime dependencies.

## Skills

- [sitemap-overview](@warlock.js/sitemap/sitemap-overview/SKILL.md): @warlock.js/sitemap — overview in @warlock.js/sitemap; use when you need to sitemap overview.
